credential_language_rule: L_cred is the subset of atom types independently eligible under Gate V3-A1; labels are never selected from reconstruction or authentication outcomes

confidence_contract.scope: component-local ranking and predeclared component thresholding only
confidence_contract.threshold_source: development split only; frozen before validation

observation_canonicalisation.collection_order: lexicographic over each record's complete canonical tuple
observation_canonicalisation.serialization: same canonical UTF-8 JSON rule as compiler output

operations_in_order: validate component provenance and local confidence domains
discard only predeclared below-threshold or explicitly abstained observations
resolve duplicates by frozen category-aware NMS and deterministic tie-breaks
assign canonical node IDs after deterministic category-box ordering
attach supported attributes, unary actions, and binary interactions
derive spatial relations from accepted boxes
normalise inverse relations and collapse exact duplicates
sort every collection and serialize canonical UTF-8 JSON

duplicate_rule.winner: higher component-local confidence, then smaller box area, then lexicographic source tuple
duplicate_rule.cross_category_overlap: retain unless an exact predeclared alias rule applies

geometry_rules.inside: at least 0.90 of source area lies inside target
geometry_rules.on: source bottom is within 0.08 image height of target top and horizontal overlap/source width >= 0.50
geometry_rules.under: target is above source under the on vertical/horizontal tolerances

compiler.count_rule: derive one bucket for every accepted entity category; never accept model-authored counts
compiler.maximum_node_rule: more than eight accepted credential entities returns TOO_MANY_CREDENTIAL_ENTITIES; never truncate silently
compiler.unsupported_type_rule: an ineligible type is omitted from L_cred with an audit event; a label outside L_visual is UNKNOWN_LABEL
compiler.canonical_serialization: UTF-8, Unicode NFKC, lowercase ASCII vocabulary tokens, sorted keys, arrays in specified deterministic order, separators comma/colon, newline terminated

pipelines.scientific_role: compositional open-set entity localization followed by closed-label crop, pair-crop, and global scoring

adapter.detection_query: all entity_categories joined by period-space in config order
adapter.entity_threshold: fit one global detector threshold on development only, then freeze
adapter.single_crop: tight detection box plus 10 percent of box width/height padding, clipped to image
adapter.pair_crop: union of source and target boxes plus 10 percent padding; draw a two-pixel red source border and two-pixel blue target border
adapter.binary_template: a photo of the red-box {source_category} {binary_interaction} the blue-box {target_category}
adapter.score_rule: SigLIP component logits scored only against the complete label set for that task; one task threshold and minimum top-two margin fitted on development, then frozen

components.output: closed-label similarity scores for crop attributes/actions, ordered pair-crop interactions, and global scene

pipelines.scientific_role: end-to-end entity/predicate proposal and graph assembly, with an independent contrastive component for attributes and scene

adapter.sgtr_label_rule: lowercase, replace spaces and hyphens with underscores, then accept exact L_visual token intersection only; no learned or hand-authored aliases
adapter.sgtr_entity_threshold: fit one global entity threshold on development only, then freeze
adapter.sgtr_predicate_threshold: fit one global predicate threshold on development only, then freeze
adapter.inverse_rule: apply the compiler inverse_normalisation table after exact-token intersection
adapter.siglip_single_crop: tight SGTR entity box plus 10 percent padding, clipped to image
adapter.siglip_score_rule: score the complete label set per task; fit one task threshold and top-two margin on development, then freeze

components.checkpoint_identity: official SGTR(VG) checkpoint linked from MODELZOO.md
components.license: Apache-2.0 code; checkpoint terms must be recorded and approved before acquisition
components.activation_precondition: record official checkpoint URL, terms, byte count, and SHA-256; fail closed if terms are absent or incompatible
components.output: entity proposals, boxes, predicate triplets, and component-local scores
closed-label crop attributes and global scene scores
